decisions.reason: Close to the established handcrafted line and prominently featured on the home page, so high sunk investment, visibility, and centrality lead management to persist despite any disappointing results.
As a traditional one-tier pyramid close to the firm's core craft, it benefits from high sunk costs and public commitment, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.

Although distant from the established offer, the electronic music box was shown on the home page and represents a visible new direction, so management resists dropping due to prior investment and public commitment.
The motif platform received its own page and a second edition, indicating continued investment and justification of the earlier decision, so escalation of commitment keeps it on the market.
As a seasonal Christmas platform for the music box, disappointing results can be attributed to temporary seasonal demand, and the firm's earlier public launch creates pressure to justify and persist.
Building on the established offer with a Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid and shown on the home page, it is highly central and visibly committed, so management continues despite any shortfall.
